spellbook.finance/limitations: This is a rolling seven-UTC-date window, not a complete calendar-week or market-wide census. Missing publications are listed without substituting another day.
pctAbovePrevious uses percent units: 25 means 25%. Reported prices are USD reference values, not executable offers or net proceeds.
recordedComputedAt is a synthetic snapshot-date end marker. retrievedAt dates this read. Independent provider price clocks, price-source printing identity and history start remain unknown.

Current catalog checks verify a reported Magic label and oracle match; they do not validate a historical price for that printing. The upstream detector and returned distinct-card list are capped; preserve truncation and excluded-row counts.

annotations.title: Read Magic ATH observations for seven dates

description: Read retained Magic card-level high-price detector observations for seven explicit UTC dates and one finish. Use it for which Magic cards hit an all-time high this week. Returns reported USD values, percent-unit changes, catalog-checked Magic labels, publication dates, missing days and coverage limits. Defaults to seven dates ending today and regular finish. Stored ATH state is per oracleId and finish; the reported printing label does not establish which printing supplied the historical price. Read guideResourceUri through MCP for metric, date and identity interpretation. Observations are not independently verified market-wide lifetime highs or trade recommendations.

endDate.description: Last inclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today. Exactly six earlier dates are also requested; missing dates stay missing.

priceType.description: Requested finish. Defaults to regular (nonfoil); foil is a separate read.
